subject.title: improve(gateway): bound visible history page reads

question: Should the gateway HTTP history endpoint adopt opaque generation-aware `nextCursor` values now, with legacy numeric inputs accepted only for the stated upgrade window?
rationale: This is a public compatibility choice for existing HTTP consumers, not a mechanical implementation detail; the PR’s tests can validate the selected policy but cannot choose the supported transition duration or contract.

options.title: Accept bounded transition
options.body: Approve opaque emitted cursors while preserving numeric cursor input for a defined transition window, then require exact-head upgrade and live HTTP/SSE proof.

options.title: Preserve numeric emitted cursors
options.body: Keep emitting numeric cursors and use the opaque cursor only internally until a separately approved API transition is designed.

options.title: Pause API change
options.body: Keep the bounded reader work but defer cursor-contract changes until an owner defines versioning or documented client migration behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded transition
recommendation.body: Approve opaque emitted cursors while preserving numeric cursor input for a defined transition window, then require exact-head upgrade and live HTTP/SSE proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged bounded-history foundation and are the strongest history signal for the gateway cursor compatibility decision.
